scope_note: The sources establish classical finite-field subspace-arrangement counting via intersection posets and characteristic polynomials. C043 contributes a charged proof-carrying specialization for polynomially bounded signed intersection support; it does not claim a new general invariant or solve unrestricted SAT.

sources.role: Primary finite-field method relating complement counts to arrangement characteristic polynomials.
sources.title: Characteristic Polynomials of Subspace Arrangements and Finite Fields

sources.role: Primary context for counting points on and off unions of linear or affine subspaces over finite fields from combinatorial arrangement data.
sources.title: Subspace Arrangements over Finite Fields: Cohomological and Enumerative Aspects

sources.role: Primary valuation and characteristic-polynomial context for subspace arrangements.
